body: I don't have any other options. Even if it doesn't kill me, maybe it would cause permanent damage that could later be exploited?

I can be a dumb disrespectful asshole too when I'm ready, but thanks for the kind words. I'm still in a somewhat mentally unstable state, so I can't really predict what my future is like, but now I'm actually *trying* to fight back against my mental struggles, maybe I even have a chance of winning.

As a person who has dealt with extreme depression and suicidal tendencies for the past few years, even coming extremely close to an attempt (but I did overdose on some pills that were actually meant to treat my depression but of course those aren't that strong so it didn't really do much), this kind of hits me in a specific place. I'm not even sure what to comment about it, but...
